scope.domain: External finite R-modules, R = Z/(p^K), prime p and positive K
allowed_operations: Add labeled known-constraint submodules while retaining the original target
Apply specified surjective R-linear coordinate maps
Compose finitely many of these operations with exact transport of all input labels
scope.native_bridge: External algebraic carrier/readout only. No claim changes P000/native X6 or exports a Cell address.

state.Q: An exact finite ambient module presentation, initially V/A
state.q: Actual quotient map V -> Q with original input/control labeling
state.D_embedded: The actual target image q(B) as a submodule of Q
state.coordinate_identifications: Exact identifications needed to interpret constraints after each surjective coordinate change
not_sufficient: abstract types of Q and D alone
only individually computed kernels for a table of controls

operations.name: add_constraints
operations.input: Current marked state and exact submodule C in its current labeled coordinate domain
operations.output: (Q/U, pi o q, pi(D_embedded)), retaining all coordinate identifications
operations.certificate: D_new is canonically D_embedded/(D_embedded intersect U)

operations.name: surjective_coordinate_cut
operations.input: Current marked state and a specified surjective R-linear map f: V -> Vprime
operations.calculation: N = ker(f); quotient Q by q(N)
operations.output: Marked quotient identified with Vprime/f(A), with target image and future control transport
operations.certificate: Vprime/f(A) is canonically V/(A+ker(f)); target defect is the image of B

operations.name: observe
operations.output: Exact module presentation, p-adic profile, cardinality, or zero/nonzero as requested

failure_conditions: Reject an unproved non-surjective coordinate map in the cut operation

Do not infer a joint update from the sum of individually stored kernels
Do not treat a new target or inverse lift as covered by the retained-original-target theorem
